tasks.title: A charger or headphones moment ends when the panel opens and waits while the pointer rests on it
tasks.why: clearAmbient runs only on sleep and lock (NotchController.swift:86, :195). Open the panel during a 2.2 s moment, close it, and the moment resurfaces. The moment also folds under a resting pointer (the presentAmbient work item, :1359-1366).
tasks.failing_test_first: AmbientMomentTests.testOpeningThePanelEndsTheMoment: vm.ambient = a charging moment, vm.isPeeking = true, then vm.isOpen = true; assert vm.ambient == nil and vm.isPeeking == false. testAMomentWaitsForThePointer: NotchController.ambientRecheck(pointerInside: true) == 1.0 and (false) == nil. Fails today.
tasks.approach: isOpen gets a didSet that clears ambient and isPeeking when it becomes true. That runs inside the open's own withAnimation, so the moment leaves with the open. The controller's pending work items become harmless no-ops. The ambient work item re-arms for 1 s while pointer.isInside. A second moment replacing the first is kept: it already is M-20's 'one slot, fold 2.2 s after the last change'. The Announcer (F-013) belongs to the a11y group.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests green. Live: plug in the charger, open the panel within 2 s, close it, and nothing resurfaces; rest the pointer on the moment and it stays until the pointer leaves, plus 1 s.
tasks.risks: A didSet on a @Published property runs on every isOpen write; it must only clear on false → true.

tasks.title: The clipboard privacy cover hides the item count and whether a row is a link
tasks.why: With the cover on, the header still shows '6' and row 5 shows a link glyph (panel-clipboard/privacy-covered__dark.png), so a screen-share audience learns how many items there are and which is a URL.
tasks.failing_test_first: PrivacyModeTests.testTheCoverHidesCountAndKind: NotchContentView.clipboardCounter(count: 6, covered: true) == nil and (6, false) == 6; ClipRow.glyph(for: linkItem, hidden: true) == ClipRow.glyph(for: textItem, hidden: true) == "text.alignleft", and hidden: false keeps "link". Fails today.
tasks.approach: trailing's .clipboard case shows the counter only when !vm.privacy.covers(.clipboard). ClipRow shows a neutral glyph while hidden, and the justCopied checkmark still wins.
tasks.acceptance: Unit test green. Visual lab panel-clipboard/privacy-covered__dark.png shows no count and uniform glyphs; a revealed row shows its real kind.
tasks.risks: The privacy group's F-002 and M-4 work (an always-visible eye, the output cover) edits ClipRow too; this is a two-line change, so rebase.

tasks.title: 'Translate in Isla' in the Services menu is translated
tasks.why: The NSServices menu item is the English literal (Scripts/bundle.sh:69-76), and there is no ServicesMenu.strings, so a Russian Mac shows it in English.
tasks.failing_test_first: Extend Scripts/test-localizations.sh: parse every NSMenuItem default from bundle.sh, and require ServicesMenu.strings in en and ru to exist, pass plutil -lint, carry exactly those keys, keep the en value equal to the key, and give the ru value something other than English. test-package.sh asserts both files are in the bundle. Fails today: the files are missing.
tasks.approach: Add the two tables ("Translate in Isla" = "Translate in Isla"; ru "Перевести в Isla"). bundle.sh already copies every .lproj. Comments in the test scripts follow the file's language (some are Russian).
tasks.acceptance: ./scripts/check (localizations, package) green. Live: after install, `/System/Library/CoreServices/pbs -update`; in a Russian session the Services menu reads 'Перевести в Isla'.
tasks.risks: The Services cache may hold the old title until pbs refreshes. test-branding.sh is fine ('Isla').
tasks.strings_and_tokens: ServicesMenu.strings: en "Translate in Isla", ru "Перевести в Isla".

tasks.title: Russian copy uses one name for the clipboard and Apple's word for Output
tasks.why: 'Буфер' (tab and privacy row) against 'буфера обмена' elsewhere, and 'Вывод' against Apple's 'Выход' (ru.lproj:7, :167, :181). Apple's own tables decide it: Control Center Sound.loctable maps 'Output' to 'Выход' and 'Output device' to 'Устройство выхода звука'. 'пт' for points stays, because AppKit's Ruler.loctable and FontManager.loctable map 'pt' to 'пт', so the Friday reading is refuted.
tasks.failing_test_first: LocalizationGlossaryTests.testRussianFollowsTheGlossary reads Resources/ru.lproj/Localizable.strings through #filePath. Asserts: "Clipboard" == "Буфер обмена"; "Output" == "Выход"; "Sound Output" == "Выход звука"; "%d pt" == "%d пт". Fails today on the first three.
tasks.approach: Change the three values and add a glossary comment at the top of the ru table naming the canonical terms and their Apple source. Check that 'БУФЕР ОБМЕНА' fits the open header and the Settings privacy row at 480 pt in the ru render. The privacy row's wording (H-004) belongs to the settings group and will reuse the term.
tasks.acceptance: Test green; test-localizations.sh green; visual lab ru renders of panel-clipboard (header) and lock-card output picker at w480 fit.
tasks.risks: The 'Clipboard' key also titles the privacy-cover section, so H-004's rename must use the same term.
tasks.strings_and_tokens: ru values only: "Clipboard" = "Буфер обмена"; "Output" = "Выход"; "Sound Output" = "Выход звука".

decisions_made.decision: Settings toggles: the whole row is the switch's label and hit target, drawn by a custom IslaSwitchStyle (CT-01).
decisions_made.reasoning: Accessibility wins (CEO policy 2). A detached 24×14 target fails CTL-01, and the same change closes P1 H-002. It is not a recorded owner request, only an open item at checklist.md:510.

decisions_made.decision: Under Reduce Motion the locked-island refusal plays as a 0.36 s opacity dip of the pill content (MO-02) instead of nothing.
decisions_made.reasoning: apple-design section 14: reduced motion means a gentler, non-vestibular equivalent, not no feedback. 'Nothing honest to substitute' is a code comment, not an owner request. The VoiceOver half belongs to the F-013 Announcer.

decisions_made.decision: Raise the lyric context floor to 0.36 (3.13:1) and the neighbour to 0.42 (3.95:1), add a card ramp that holds over the cover light, and make credits follow Increase Contrast (CT-02).
decisions_made.reasoning: Accessibility beats a depth preference (policy 2). Depth survives as 0.36 → 0.42 → 0.50 → 1.0, and the opacity-only decision is kept (no blur).

decisions_made.decision: Record the fixed type roles (caption 10, body 11, no Dynamic Type) as a dated scope divergence in checklist.md (CT-03). A one-step larger-text setting is deferred to the owner.
decisions_made.reasoning: The windows are cut once and never resized (CLAUDE.md), so larger text touches every fixed layout. That is a product decision, not a token change. Recording it makes the divergence honest now.

decisions_made.decision: The lock-card heart keeps working. checklist.md records that it writes the connected account's Liked Songs from the lock screen.
decisions_made.reasoning: Connecting Spotify is already opt-in and default off, which is the consent policy 1 asks for. The heart is the account's only feature (the only toggleSaved caller). The audit's gap was the missing record, and that is what this fixes.

decisions_made.decision: No damping value changes. Fix the stale comments and test citations (MO-03). The caption gets its own critically damped pair (MO-04) instead of borrowing the overshooting lyricScroll.
decisions_made.reasoning: The hover bump was the owner's 2026-09-21 request (policy 3). Whether 0.58 pt reads as a bump needs the owner's live A/B, not a planner's guess.

decisions_made.decision: No extra click before hot-key clipboard text goes online. The online engine is used only with Translate Online switched on (default off) and only after the user pressed ⌃⌥⌘T.
decisions_made.reasoning: There are two explicit consents. The unconsented route the audit found is the misdetection (G-014, fixed in TR-01) and the resend (G-026, fixed in TR-05).

decisions_made.decision: Keep the fixed 40 pt two-line lyric slots. Only add the edge fade (LY-01).
decisions_made.reasoning: This is a deliberate trade for arithmetic scrolling, recorded in code. Policy 3 and policy 5 (no refactor beyond the finding).

decisions_made.decision: Leave the 0.4 s paused-pill fold as it is. MO-03 changes the fold curve, not the linger.
decisions_made.reasoning: This is an explicit owner request dated 2026-09-21 (policy 3). A longer linger after track changes is media-state logic for the media group.

decisions_made.decision: The lock card and its popover always use the drawn recipe (LC-02).
decisions_made.reasoning: The binding checklist record says drawn because nothing above the shield is given a backdrop. Code follows the record. The owner can amend the record after a live look.

decisions_made.decision: Make the fold equal to the unfold at 0.42 s with content-out at 0.20 s. Do not take H-013's 0.32 s fold.
decisions_made.reasoning: 0.32 s sits 0.04 s from the 0.28 s the owner called a snap. 0.42 s keeps the test floor of 0.4 and cuts the empty-wing time from 296 to 232 ms.

decisions_made.decision: Tinted and Solid guarantee 4.5:1 over the brightest cover. Transparent guarantees it over its cover portion. The see-through wallpaper part is recorded as a divergence in checklist.md.
decisions_made.reasoning: The wallpaper above the shield cannot be measured. Forcing 4.5:1 there means a near-opaque card (wash 0.89 at 75% opacity over white), which removes the style. Increase Contrast already makes Transparent opaque.

deferred.item: H-013 full target (fold within about 100 ms of the content, fold response about 0.32 s)
deferred.reason: Needs a fold faster than the 0.4 s floor that protects the owner's 2026-09-21 'not a snap' request. MO-03 ships the safe half (232 ms instead of 296 ms). Owner decides after a live look.

deferred.item: H-028 residual: re-opening mid-close restarts the body fade from 0
deferred.reason: Timing curves do not merge in SwiftUI. Fixing it needs the body opacity driven by a spring (a larger change across the open choreography). MO-01 removes the peak-speed ending.

deferred.item: Volume or brightness HUD, Developer ID build, in-app updater
deferred.reason: Owner-level product decisions (CEO policy 4). A HUD needs a system-wide key intercept and duplicates macOS's own. Developer ID costs the release owner's credentials and money, but fixes the Gatekeeper helper alert. An updater needs Developer ID to sign a feed.

deferred.item: One-step larger-text setting (owner decision 10)
deferred.reason: Touches every fixed-size window and the lock card's never-resized layout. It is a product decision. CT-03 records the divergence now.

deferred.item: M-16 swap button centred at 24×24
deferred.reason: The 18×14 target is F-014 (hit-targets group). Moving it between the columns redoes textArea math, which TR-03 depends on. Do it after TR-03 with the hit-targets group.

deferred.item: M-24 visible output name caption under the lock-card rail
deferred.reason: The 412 pt rail already carries the volume bar. LC-04 ships the accessibility half (value and tooltip). The visible caption needs the owner's call on crowding.

deferred.item: M-26 language picker (Detected sub-label, Recents, status suffix), M-30 availability before translating, M-37 speak the text
deferred.reason: New Translate features with no finding behind them (policy 5). M-26 also waits on a panel-wide capitals decision. Next after the findings close.

deferred.item: M-33 long titles: edge fade and a single marquee pass
deferred.reason: No finding. A marquee adds motion on an idle surface, and the edge fade needs overflow measurement on every title. Lower gain than the open defects.

deferred.item: M-25 'Online · MyMemory' chip and ask-before-send
deferred.reason: Owner decision 21 is resolved as no extra ask. The chip relabel is copy polish for the feedback-errors group.

deferred.item: M-10 remedy sets per failure kind, M-11 placeholder and 'clipboard has no text', M-3 'Live' label and no-length lyric states, M-36 interlude marker, M-6 Announcer
deferred.reason: These belong to F-042 and F-049 (feedback-errors), F-030 and F-040 (a11y and feedback), F-007 (lyrics) and F-013 (a11y). TR-04's OfferButtonStyle and LC-06's no-bar state are what they build on.

deferred.item: M-19 coalesced volume writes and device re-reads
deferred.reason: That is F-045 (perf group) in the same gesture. LC-05 takes the balance, mute and grab-height half and rebases on theirs.

deferred.item: True cross-dissolve of the shell under Reduce Motion
deferred.reason: Needs two shape layers and a full-size black slab fading in (L effort). MO-05's 0.24 s ease-in-out removes the first-frame jump and halves peak speed.

deferred.item: Owner decisions 15, 16, 24 (Escape clears Translate text, pointer-away folds while typing, arrow cursor over the editor)
deferred.reason: Each lives in shell code (NotchViewModel.consumeEscape, NotchController's pointer fold, NotchRootView's cursor) that the keyboard-shell group owns with F-004 and owner decision 1.

deferred.item: Visual lab finding 5 as a definite defect
deferred.reason: The host renderer draws no layer masks, so the stage's existing mask may simply not appear in the render. LY-01 confirms it live and fixes it only if it is real.
